= Link labels

:relfilesuffix: .xhtml

[source,rust,subs="+quotes,+macros"]
----
<<outer>>
let a = link:https://example.org/a[*Bold*];
*link:https://example.org/nested[Nested]*
((link:https://example.org/index[Index link]))
<<#,Top>> xref:other.adoc#target[]
link:https://example.org/id[ID label,id=code-link,role=custom,window=_blank]
https://example.org/hidden[] <dev@example.org>
----

<<code-link>>

----
link:https://example.org/empty[(((Hidden label))),id=empty-code]after
----

[source,rust,subs=+macros]
----
link:https://example.org/empty-block[(((Hidden block))),id=empty-block]
----

<<empty-code>> and <<empty-block>>.
